# Munikumar — Digital Marketing, SEO & Growth Strategy

> Official website for Munikumar, a digital marketing growth studio focused on SEO, AEO, GEO, paid acquisition, social media, content, conversion optimization, and analytics.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://munikumar.vercel.app/): Overview of services, approach, and growth planning.
- [Services](https://munikumar.vercel.app/services/): SEO, paid acquisition, social, content, conversion, analytics, and growth strategy.
- [About](https://munikumar.vercel.app/about/): Studio approach and operating model.
- [Insights](https://munikumar.vercel.app/insights/): Educational content on SEO, AEO, GEO, and digital growth.
- [FAQ](https://munikumar.vercel.app/faq/): Answers to common digital marketing and search questions.
- [SEO & SMO Report](https://munikumar.vercel.app/seo-report/): Free browser-based SEO and social profile report generator.

## Core topics

- Search Engine Optimization (SEO)
- Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)
- Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)
- Paid advertising and acquisition
- Content and social media marketing
- Conversion optimization and analytics

## Notes

Content on this website is informational and describes services and marketing frameworks. Performance examples on the site are illustrative, not guaranteed outcomes.
